description: Look up Georgia standards by their codes (e.g. ['5.NR.1', '3.T.C.1', 'S8P1', 'SS8H1.a']). Returns the matching standards (each with `code`, `statement`, optional `notes` and `path`), plus per-code `alds` (achievement-level descriptions), `assessment_coverage` (Milestones claim, target, approx_points, qualifier), and `assessment_metadata` keyed by assessment_id; the server instructions explain how to read points, qualifiers, and levels. A sub-code (e.g. '5.NR.3.3') with no descriptors of its own shows its parent standard's. Older codes from earlier materials (MGSE, ELAGSE, CCGPS) are translated to the current code when the mapping is unambiguous, including renamed math strands (fractions moved from `NF` to the current `5.NR.3` cluster), and reported in `normalized_codes`. Codes that still don't match appear in `unknown_codes` with likely `suggestions`.

codes.description: One or more standard codes, e.g. ['5.NR.1', 'S8P1'].
